tldr: 台股上一交易日收黑589點至44,719，台積電回檔30元，外資買賣超動向仍是後市關鍵。
AI 熱潮續旺，2026 台企獲利增幅上修至近五成，先進封裝與伺服器供應鏈需求全面擴散。
金管會強化存戶與樂齡防護，台灣財富管理規模衝上 36 兆元，ETF 與高資產業務領軍成長。
聯準會升息 1 碼至 3.75%~4.00%、三年來首度升息，壓抑全球風險資產，外資進出台股成觀察重點。
油價上週線大致持平，西德州原油約 100 美元、布蘭特約 104 美元，惟因中東衝突憂慮，9 月來累漲逾 18%。

items.title_zh: 台股上一交易日重挫589點 台積電失守2,350元
items.title_en: TAIEX tumbles 589 points at latest close as TSMC slips below NT$2,350
items.summary_zh: 加權指數上一交易日終場下跌589點、跌幅1.3%，收在44,719點，成交量8,478億元，權值王台積電下跌30元至2,350元。此波回檔為強漲後的獲利了結，加上市場對國際風險事件保持觀望，電子權值股領跌；惟外資買賣超動向仍是左右指數後續方向的關鍵。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index ended the most recent session down 589 points, or 1.3%, at 44,719 on turnover of NT$847.9 billion, with bellwether TSMC falling NT$30 to NT$2,350. The pullback marked profit-taking after a strong run and caution ahead of global risk events; heavyweight electronics led the retreat, and foreign-institutional positioning remains the decisive factor for the index's next leg.

items.title_zh: 台積電ADR上漲1.02%收434.67美元 為權值股提供支撐
items.title_en: TSMC ADR gains 1.02% to US$434.67, cushioning heavyweight tech
items.summary_zh: 台積電美股掛牌ADR上一交易日上漲4.41美元、漲幅1.02%，收在434.67美元，為台股台積電與大型權值股提供正向指引。在AI資本支出循環延續下，法人認為海外需求可支撐評價，惟短線方向仍取決於外資在現貨市場的買賣超力道。
items.summary_en: TSMC's US-listed ADR rose US$4.41, or 1.02%, to US$434.67 in the latest session, offering a supportive lead for the chipmaker's Taipei-listed shares and index heavyweights. With the AI capex cycle intact, analysts see overseas demand underpinning valuations, though near-term direction hinges on foreign buying and selling in the cash market.

items.title_zh: AI熱潮推升台企獲利展望上看5成
items.title_en: AI boom lifts Taiwan corporate earnings outlook toward 50% growth
items.summary_zh: 彭博預估台灣企業2026年獲利將成長約50%，接近去年底預期的近三倍，分析師持續依AI需求上修獲利。受惠範圍從台積電、鴻海擴散至中型科技股，涵蓋整櫃式伺服器、液冷散熱、PCB／CCL、電源供應、HBM／CoWoS與矽光子等領域，帶動供應鏈全面轉旺。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg estimates Taiwanese companies' 2026 profits will climb about 50%, nearly triple the forecast set late last year, as analysts keep upgrading earnings on AI demand. The tailwind is broadening beyond TSMC and Hon Hai to mid-cap tech, spanning rack-scale servers, liquid cooling, PCB/CCL, power supply, HBM/CoWoS and silicon photonics.

items.title_zh: SEMICON Taiwan 2026規模創高 先進封裝成主戰場
items.title_en: SEMICON Taiwan 2026 draws record 1,300 firms as advanced packaging takes center stage
items.summary_zh: SEMICON Taiwan 2026半導體展匯聚逾1,300家指標企業、4,300個攤位雙創新高，聚焦AI驅動下的先進封裝、小晶片、晶圓廠智慧化與量子運算等前瞻技術。台積電與日月光引領先進封裝議題，凸顯台灣在矽光子到高速傳輸等下一波AI硬體供應鏈的關鍵地位。
items.summary_en: The SEMICON Taiwan 2026 show gathered a record 1,300-plus companies across 4,300 booths, spotlighting AI-driven advanced packaging, chiplets, smart fabs and quantum computing. TSMC and ASE led the packaging agenda, underscoring Taiwan's pivotal role in the next phase of the AI hardware supply chain from silicon photonics to high-speed interconnects.

items.title_zh: 金管會示警勿用未核准機構 並推安養信託護樂齡
items.title_en: FSC warns public against unlicensed financial platforms and rolls out elder-care trust push
items.summary_zh: 金管會提醒民眾勿透過未經核准在台設立據點之金融機構進行投資，以防跨境詐騙、維護自身權益；同時推出「安養信託助力，守護樂齡生活」措施，守護退休族資產，為結合檢警的防詐與消費者保護整體行動一環。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission urged investors not to route money through financial institutions lacking approved local branches, aiming to protect savers from cross-border scams. It also launched an "elder-care trust" initiative to safeguard retirees' assets, part of a broader anti-fraud and consumer-protection drive coordinated with law-enforcement agencies.

items.title_zh: 7大銀行提款轉帳新制9月上路 額度縮水防詐
items.title_en: New bank withdrawal and transfer curbs take effect at seven major lenders
items.summary_zh: 自9月1日起，全國7大銀行依防詐新規調整ATM提款與轉帳額度，部分民眾出現「戶頭有錢卻一時領不出」情況。此舉為主管機關升級防詐架構的一環，以部分便利性換取存戶帳戶更強的安全防護，反映金融業防堵金融犯罪的政策方向。
items.summary_en: From September 1, seven major Taiwanese banks tightened ATM withdrawal and transfer limits under new rules designed to curb fraud, meaning some customers found funds harder to move immediately. The measures form part of the regulator's escalating anti-scam framework, trading a degree of convenience for stronger safeguards on depositors' accounts.

items.title_zh: 台灣財富管理規模衝上36兆 ETF與高資產領軍
items.title_en: Taiwan's wealth-management pool swells to NT$36tn, led by ETFs and the ultra-rich
items.summary_zh: 台灣財富管理規模6年內從不到20兆成長到36兆元，涵蓋基金、全權委託、銀行信託、高資產業務與保險。境內基金3年由4.86兆增至11.38兆，其中ETF一項就達7.4兆、3年成長220%，正重塑家庭與私銀的資產配置邏輯，也帶動業者競逐財管與傳承商機。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's wealth-management assets have grown from under NT$20tn to NT$36tn in six years, spanning funds, discretionary accounts, bank trusts, high-net-worth services and insurance. Onshore funds jumped from NT$4.86tn to NT$11.38tn in three years, with ETFs alone at NT$7.4tn after 220% growth, reshaping how households and private banks allocate capital.

items.title_zh: 高資產族群激增 10億元以上客戶近三倍
items.title_en: High-net-worth ranks surge as NT$1bn-plus clients nearly triple
items.summary_zh: 台灣高資產人數2年增加2.5萬人，其中10億元以上族群人數翻近三倍、資產由4.5兆暴增至18.7兆元。人身保險保費達2.62兆、產險2,868億元，銀行通路即賣出4,053億元，顯示保險與信託已成資產配置與財富傳承的核心載體，牽動私銀與高資產業務布局。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's high-net-worth population rose by 25,000 in two years, with the NT$1bn-plus tier nearly tripling and its assets ballooning from NT$4.5tn to NT$18.7tn. Insurance premiums reached NT$2.62tn in life and NT$286.8bn in non-life, with banks selling NT$405.3bn through their channels, underscoring insurance and trusts as core vehicles for asset allocation and wealth succession.

items.title_zh: 2026報稅綜所稅全面減稅 家庭稅負減輕
items.title_en: 2026 income-tax filing brings broad-based cuts for households
items.summary_zh: 台灣2026年綜所稅制擴大減稅：免稅額調高至10.1萬元、單身標準扣除額13.6萬元、薪資所得特別扣除額22.7萬元，並將租屋支出改列特別扣除額，同時調整課稅級距金額。此波調整提高薪資族與家庭的可支配所得，於物價上揚之際減輕稅負，也牽動個人理財與節稅規劃。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 2026 individual income-tax rules deliver wider relief: a higher personal exemption of NT$101,000, a single-filer standard deduction of NT$136,000 and a salary-income deduction of NT$227,000, plus rental spending reclassified as a special deduction and adjusted tax brackets. The changes lift take-home pay for wage earners and families, easing the burden as living costs rise.

items.title_zh: 遺產稅級距因CPI上漲12.42%調升 免稅額維持不變
items.title_en: Estate-tax brackets adjust upward on CPI, while exemptions hold
items.summary_zh: 因累計消費者物價指數上漲12.42%、達法定調整門檻，2026年遺產稅課稅級距金額調升，惟免稅額與各項扣除額維持不變。級距上調使高額遺產的實質稅負略為減輕，也讓高資產家庭的傳承規劃、信託與贈與安排持續成為關注焦點。
items.summary_en: With cumulative CPI up 12.42% and crossing the statutory trigger, Taiwan's estate-tax bracket thresholds are raised for 2026, though the tax-free exemption and deduction items are left unchanged. The bracket shift modestly softens effective rates for larger estates, keeping succession planning, trusts and gifting arrangements in focus for high-net-worth families.

items.title_zh: 央行維持政策利率不變 關注AI鏈與地緣風險
items.title_en: Central bank holds policy rates, flags AI and geopolitical risks
items.summary_zh: 台灣央行維持政策利率不變，評估國內通膨展望溫和、可續低於2%，且經濟成長力道尚屬穩健。央行強調將密切關注AI供應鏈發展、美國經貿政策衝擊、中國大陸成長動能放緩、主要經濟體貨幣政策步調，以及地緣政治與極端氣候等不確定性，作為左右後續展望的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank kept its policy rates steady, judging domestic inflation will stay moderate and below 2% while growth momentum remains stable. Policymakers pledged to closely watch AI-supply-chain developments, the impact of U.S. trade policy, China's slowing growth, major-economy rate paths and geopolitical and climate uncertainties as key swing factors for the outlook.

items.title_zh: 物價維持溫和 主計總處更新統計
items.title_en: Consumer prices stay contained as statistics agency updates data
items.summary_zh: 主計總處公布的物價統計顯示國內消費者通膨相對受控，支撐央行維持利率不變的立場。在價格壓力自前波高點回落之際，總經環境為政策穩定保留空間，惟主管機關仍持續留意進口能源成本與全球供給面衝擊對國內物價的潛在傳導。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's official price data show consumer inflation remaining relatively contained, supporting the central bank's steady-rate stance. With price pressures easing from earlier peaks, the macro backdrop leaves room for policy stability, though authorities continue to monitor imported-energy costs and global supply shocks that could feed through to domestic prices.

items.title_zh: 聯準會升息1碼至3.75%~4.00% 三年來首度升息
items.title_en: Fed raises rates a quarter point to 3.75%–4.00%, its first hike in three years
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經媒體報導，聯準會9月會議升息1碼、將目標區間上調至3.75%~4.00%，為三年來首度升息，以對抗僵固的通膨。主席華許強調通膨風險，市場聚焦點陣圖解讀政策路徑。此決議壓抑利率敏感型資產，並形塑台股與債市的外部環境，成為外資動向的重要變數。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese financial media report the Federal Reserve lifted its target range by a quarter point to 3.75%–4.00% at its September meeting, its first increase in three years as it battles sticky inflation. Chair Kevin Warsh stressed inflation risks, and markets are parsing the dot plot for the policy path—an outcome that pressures rate-sensitive assets and shapes the backdrop for Taiwan equities and bonds.

items.title_zh: 點陣圖成焦點 市場評估後續升息空間
items.title_en: Dot plot in focus as market weighs whether more hikes lie ahead
items.summary_zh: 在聯準會利率預測受矚目下，台灣分析師熱議央行對2026年剩餘時間釋出的升息訊號，及其對股市、債市與匯率的連動。美國利率路徑連同居高不下的美債殖利率，仍是主導全球風險胃納與外資進出台股的關鍵力量，牽動後續資產配置方向。
items.summary_en: With the Fed's projections in the spotlight, Taiwanese analysts are debating how many further moves the central bank signals for the rest of 2026 and how that ripples into equities, bonds and the currency. The path of U.S. rates—alongside elevated Treasury yields—remains a dominant driver for global risk appetite and for foreign flows into Taiwan's market.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂

items.title_zh: 標普小跌、道瓊連三週下挫（2026-09-18，最近交易日）
items.title_en: S&P 500 slips, Dow logs third straight weekly loss after Fed's first hike in three years (2026-09-18, latest session)
items.summary_zh: 美股最近交易日收盤漲跌互見，標普500下跌約0.1%、科技股居多的那斯達克上漲0.7%，道瓊則收第三個下跌週、單週跌1.7%創3月來最差。市場承壓源於聯準會三年來首度升息以對抗僵固通膨，加上美債殖利率居高不下，投資人持續評估利率政策走向。
items.summary_en: U.S. stocks closed the latest session mixed, with the S&P 500 off about 0.1% and the tech-heavy Nasdaq up 0.7%, while the Dow finished a third straight losing week, down 1.7% for its worst stretch since March. The weakness followed the Fed's first rate hike in three years as it fights sticky inflation amid elevated bond yields.

items.title_zh: 油價週線持平 沙國管線疑慮緩解；9月來仍漲逾18%（2026-09-18）
items.title_en: Oil ends week flat as Saudi pipeline fears ease; crude up ~18% in September (2026-09-18)
items.summary_zh: 西德州中級原油上週五下跌1.6%、收每桶100.30美元，布蘭特原油跌0.9%至103.87美元，為連三日走低，使週線大致持平；市場認為沙烏地阿拉伯東西向管線關閉的衝擊小於預期。惟因憂心中東衝突延長，油價9月以來仍累漲逾18%，成為全球通膨與利率前景的重要變數。
items.summary_en: WTI crude fell 1.6% to settle at $100.30 a barrel and Brent eased 0.9% to $103.87 on Friday, a third straight decline that left prices roughly flat for the week as the market judged the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown less disruptive than feared. Even so, oil has climbed more than 18% in September on fears of a prolonged Middle East conflict.

items.title_zh: 華爾街帶著聯準會引發的跌勢進入新一週（2026-09-20）
items.title_en: Wall Street heads into new week nursing Fed-driven losses (2026-09-20)
items.summary_zh: 進入新交易週，美股仍在消化道瓊連三週下跌與聯準會三年來首度升息的衝擊，僵固通膨與偏高的美債殖利率使市場情緒保持謹慎。投資人聚焦決策者可能的緊縮幅度，以及對利率敏感的科技與成長股的後續影響，觀望氣氛主導短線盤勢。
items.summary_en: Heading into the new trading week, U.S. markets were still digesting the Dow's third consecutive weekly decline and the Fed's first hike in three years, with sticky inflation and elevated Treasury yields keeping sentiment cautious. Investors are focused on how far policymakers may tighten and on the read-through for rate-sensitive technology and growth stocks.
